svg.text: Single AI call · projected score · per-edit impact breakdown · no circular loop

g.text: Step 2: Single AI call (the ONLY AI call in entire flow)
Returns: current scores + projected scores + all edits with impact breakdowns
Layer 1: Will your resume be FOUND? (ATS ranking)
= sum(tier weight × placement multiplier) / sum(all weights)
Layer 2: Will a recruiter SHORTLIST you? (human eval)
Step 3: Edit recommendations (from same AI call)
Step 4: Each edit shows per-point impact breakdown
Current: "Led a $1.5M annual commercial operations program..."
Suggested: "Led product delivery for a $1.5M program, owning roadmap..."
+4 Improves narrative coherence for PM positioning
2. Max 2 new keywords per rewrite (no stuffing)
3. Must cite source from projectContext or repo
4. "6-second test": reads natural to scanning recruiter
Step 5: User accepts / declines each edit
Step 6: Live score update (deterministic, no 2nd AI call)
Example: original 52, projected 72, accepted 60% of impact
New score = 52 + (20 × 0.60) = 64. Each dimension also interpolated.
Format stays locked — bullet edits don't affect ATS parsing.
Live running total (updates instantly on each accept/decline)
Accepted 3 of 5 edits | +13 points | Score: 52 → 65 | Potential was 72
Three-column score table (replaces old delta card)
Skills / Relevance / Fit / Format — same pattern
"Started at 52. Accepted 3 of 5 edits. Your score: 65. Full potential was 72."
ATS doesn't reject — it ranks. Our job: rank top 20, impress in 6 seconds.
